steps.name: Run stratified benchmark
steps.run:
LIMIT="${{ github.event.inputs.limit || '100' }}"
SEED="${{ github.event.inputs.seed || '42' }}"
if [ -n "${{ github.event.inputs.random_sample }}" ]; then
  python scripts/run_benchmark_loop.py \
    --random-sample "${{ github.event.inputs.random_sample }}" \
    --seed "$SEED" \
    --validate
else
  python scripts/run_benchmark_loop.py \
    --corpus popular-100 \
    --limit "$LIMIT" \
    --seed "$SEED" \
    --validate
fi

steps.name: Commit updated exports/latest artifacts
steps.run:
git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
git add exports/latest/
if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
  git commit -m "chore(benchmark): update exports/latest telemetry"
  git push
fi
